title: Inherited IRA distribution is ordinary income, not capital gain
catches: IRC 1223(9) long-term treatment wrongly extended to IRD.

expected.reason: IRC 1223(9) requires basis determined under section 1014; 1014(c) excludes IRD.

notes: The 1223(9) rescue cannot reach IRD because 1014 never applied. If the module reports long-term capital gain on an inherited IRA distribution it has chained the two rules without checking the precondition.
